explanation:
Aphotic Shield belongs to Abaddon. Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
hint: Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

explanation: Pit of Malice belongs to Underlord. A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.
hint: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.

explanation: Unstable Concoction belongs to Alchemist. Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After 5 seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after 5.5 seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
hint: The caster brews up this ability that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. The caster is faster while charging the concoction.

explanation: Bone Chill belongs to Ancient Apparition. When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
hint: When the caster deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

explanation: Counterspell belongs to Anti-Mage. Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
hint: Passively grants magic resistance. This ability may be activated to create the caster-magic shell around the caster that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.

explanation: Magnetic Field belongs to Arc Warden. Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
hint: The caster generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. This ability grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. This ability pulls runes, and runes inside this ability automatically activate.

explanation: Battle Hunger belongs to Axe. Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
hint: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from the caster.

explanation:
Nightmare belongs to Bane. Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
hint: Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in the caster's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, this ability passes to the attacking unit. The caster can attack and damage affected targets freely. Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.

explanation: Firefly belongs to Batrider. Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
hint: The caster takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below the caster. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of this ability duration.

explanation: Summon Raptors belongs to Beastmaster. Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
hint: The caster summons 2 hawks that circle around the caster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.

explanation: Thirst belongs to Bloodseeker. Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
hint: The caster is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero.

explanation: Shadow Walk belongs to Bounty Hunter. Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell. If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
hint: The caster becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell. If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.

explanation:
Drunken Brawler belongs to Brewmaster. Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
hint: The caster can switch stances based on the elements he controls. Whenever the caster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

explanation: Quill Spray belongs to Bristleback. Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14 seconds.
hint: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around the caster. Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by this ability in the last 14 seconds.

explanation:
Spin Web belongs to Broodmother. Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
hint: Spins a large web that grants the caster a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement. This ability can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed.

explanation: Hitch A Ride belongs to Centaur Warrunner. Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.
hint: The caster tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.

explanation: Reality Rift belongs to Chaos Knight. Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.
hint: Teleports the caster, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.

explanation: Holy Persuasion belongs to Chen. Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.
hint: The caster takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. The caster may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.

explanation: Burning Barrage belongs to Clinkz. CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
hint: CHANNELED - the caster channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of the caster's attack damage and applying attack modifiers.

explanation: Crystal Clone belongs to Crystal Maiden. Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
hint: Slides in a direction, creating this ability of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by the caster's own spells.

explanation: Normal Punch belongs to Dark Seer. Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.
hint: Passive ability. Causes the caster's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far the caster has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.

explanation: Shadow Realm belongs to Dark Willow. Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable. Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.
hint: The caster recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable. Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end this ability. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of this ability, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.

explanation: Celestial Hammer belongs to Dawnbreaker. Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
hint: The caster hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. The caster can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.

explanation: Shallow Grave belongs to Dazzle. An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
hint: An ally blessed with this ability, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.

explanation: Spirit Siphon belongs to Death Prophet. Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
hint: Creates a spirit link between the caster and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.

explanation: Glimpse belongs to Disruptor. Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
hint: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago. Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance affected, that cannot go over a damage maximum.

explanation: Infernal Blade belongs to Doom. Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
hint: The caster swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.

explanation: Wyrm's Wrath belongs to Dragon Knight. The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
hint: The life blood of the caster improves the caster's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

explanation:
Glacier belongs to Drow Ranger. Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
hint: The caster creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and the caster and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. The caster gains additional damage while on this ability and attacking targets below her.

explanation: Rolling Boulder belongs to Earth Spirit. Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
hint: The caster gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.

explanation: Enchant Totem belongs to Earthshaker. Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.
hint: Empowers the caster's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.

explanation:
Astral Spirit belongs to Elder Titan. Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
hint: The caster sends forth his this ability, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the caster, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through. This ability possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.

explanation: Flame Guard belongs to Ember Spirit. Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
hint: The caster surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. This ability deals damage per second in an area around the caster while this ability is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.

explanation: Sproink belongs to Enchantress. Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.
hint: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within the caster's attack range + 100.

explanation: Demonic Summoning belongs to Enigma. Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health. The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply. When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
hint: Summons three fragments of the caster himself at the cost of health. The eidolons health is increased by 3% of the caster's current health. These eidolons are all under the caster's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply. When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

explanation: Time Dilation belongs to Faceless Void. Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
hint: The caster envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one this ability stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.

explanation: Curse of the Oldgrowth belongs to Nature's Prophet. Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

image.alt: Curse of the Oldgrowth ability icon

hint: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

explanation:
Phantom's Embrace belongs to Grimstroke. Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
hint: Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes this ability cooldown. Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.

explanation: Flak Cannon belongs to Gyrocopter. Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks. Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike. Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.
hint: The caster's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks. Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike. Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.

explanation: Decoy belongs to Hoodwink. Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
hint: The caster turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates this ability illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

explanation: Burning Spear belongs to Huskar. Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
hint: The caster sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack. Multiple attacks will stack additional damage. Each attack drains some of the caster's health.

explanation: Wex belongs to Invoker. Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.
hint: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active instances of this ability imbue the caster with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of this ability.

explanation: Liquid Frost belongs to Jakiro. Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
hint: The caster chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from the caster's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

explanation: Healing Ward belongs to Juggernaut. Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 seconds.
hint: Summons this ability which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health. This ability moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned. Lasts 18 seconds.

explanation: Blinding Light belongs to Keeper of the Light. A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.
hint: This ability flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.

explanation:
Switch Discipline belongs to Kez. Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
hint: The caster switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai. He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

explanation: X Marks the Spot belongs to Kunkka. Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds. Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.

image.alt: X Marks the Spot ability icon

hint: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds. The caster can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.

explanation:
Croak of Genius belongs to Largo. Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
hint: The caster strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds. When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for the caster himself.

explanation:
Outfight Them! belongs to Legion Commander. Passively grants Legion Commander armor.

If Legion or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.
hint: Passively grants the caster armor. If the caster or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.

explanation: Diabolic Edict belongs to Leshrac. Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings. The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
hint: Saturates the area around the caster with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings. The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.

explanation: Frost Shield belongs to Lich. Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
hint: Applies a magical this ability around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.

explanation: Open Wounds belongs to Lifestealer. Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
hint: The caster rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.

explanation: Flame Cloak belongs to Lina. Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
hint: Grants the caster unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

explanation:
Mana Drain belongs to Lion. CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%. 

 Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.
hint: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%. Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.

explanation:
Summon Spirit Bear belongs to Lone Druid. Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
hint: Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items. If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the caster, it cannot attack. The caster suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies. Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.

explanation: Lunar Blessing belongs to Luna. Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
hint: Grants attack damage to the caster and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with the caster receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, this ability is global, and the caster is blessed with bonus night vision.

explanation: Wolf Bite belongs to Lycan. Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.
hint: The caster bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. The caster and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.

explanation: Horn Toss belongs to Magnus. Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
hint: The caster tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

explanation:
Rebound belongs to Marci. Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives 15% bonus movement speed for 4s.
hint: The caster bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, the caster lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands. When this ability is set to alt-cast, the caster brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

explanation:
Bulwark belongs to Mars. Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

 Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
hint: The caster wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides. Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing the caster's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.

explanation: Gorgon's Grasp belongs to Medusa. Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
hint: The caster fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

explanation:
Poof belongs to Meepo. Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
hint: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, the caster can teleport to another copy or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. If the ability is in alt-cast state, all copies of the caster will also cast this ability to the target.

explanation: Sacred Arrow belongs to Mirana. Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.6 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
hint: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.6 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.

explanation: Tree Dance belongs to Monkey King. Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
hint: The caster jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If the caster's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3s. Taking damage while on the ground puts this ability on cooldown.

explanation:
Adaptive Strike belongs to Morphling. Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.
